name: ocean-brand-system
description: Ocean RCS brand system: rules, tokens, assets and production pipelines

scripts.build:starter: node decks/_starter/build.js && node decks/_starter/build.js 5 && node decks/_starter/build.js 10 && node decks/_catalog/build.js
scripts.starter: npm run build:starter && for f in ocean-layout-reference ocean-deck-recipe-5 ocean-deck-recipe-10 ocean-layout-catalog; do python3 scripts/qa.py output/pptx/$f.pptx --draft && bash scripts/render.sh output/pptx/$f.pptx --draft || exit 1; done
scripts.documents: python3 scripts/build_documents.py && python3 scripts/qa_pdf.py output/pdf/ocean-proposal-reference.pdf --draft && python3 scripts/qa_pdf.py output/pdf/ocean-report-reference.pdf --draft && python3 scripts/qa_pdf.py output/pdf/ocean-contract-reference.pdf --draft --legal
scripts.test: node tests/layouts.test.js && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py
